note: Compact product catalog for the Coworker's audience-building task. Seeded from src/lib/productCatalogExtras.ts (anonymized copy, industry-shape numbers). target_signals drive fit; disqualifiers are hard exclusions the institution applies and must suppress a household regardless of fit. As of v2, card products carry machine-readable `terms` so annual benefit is computed from the household's own transactions against the published rate card rather than a flat heuristic. `incumbents` holds the terms of what a household already carries, so benefit can be stated net of what they earn today.

spend_categories.note: Maps an earn category to the transaction subcategories that count toward it. Used by the benefit calculator so category math is data-driven, not regex guesswork.

card_ineligible.note: Debits that are not card purchases and therefore earn nothing on any card. Excluded from every side of the benefit calculation, including the current-earn baseline.

incumbents.note: Rate cards for cards a household already holds with us, so benefit can be stated net of what they earn today. A household whose card we do not hold gets no entry here on purpose: their current earn is unknown rather than zero, and the calculator reports gross with that gap stated instead of inventing a baseline.
